title: Baobab Organisation Admission Onboarding Contracts (ADR-BCP-018 gate ORG-09)
description:
Definition library for the organisation stages of external admission (ADR-BCP-018 sections 68-70, 99-100 and 108): identity resolution, legal verification, corporate relationship assessment, the EXTERNAL_CLIENT platform relationship, PlatformAccount assignment and the tenant's organisation mappings.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/OrganisationAdmissionRequest), not the document root.

The request is issued by the Control Plane's admission reviewer after an approved admission decision (ADR-BCP-017 section 21); it is never an applicant payload. Applicant-supplied organisation data is evidence, not canonical truth (ADR-BCP-017 section 7): identifiers are recorded as unverified claims, claimed corporate relationships are recorded PENDING_REVIEW and never verified by admission (section 69), and the platform relationship is server-authoritative (section 70), so the request has no field that could set it. Identity is resolved only on governed identifiers, never on names, and a possible duplicate quarantines the admission instead of merging organisations (sections 99-100).

admissionDecisionId.description: Identifier of the approved AdmissionDecision (ADR-BCP-017 section 21). It keys the onboarding: replaying the same decision converges on the same records and changes nothing.

identityResolutionOutcome.description: NEW_ORGANISATION: no other Organisation carries any of the applicant's governed identifiers, so the tenant's registered Organisation is the applicant Organisation. EXISTING_ORGANISATION: a reviewer resolved the applicant to an existing Organisation. QUARANTINED: another Organisation carries a matching governed identifier and no reviewer resolution was supplied; nothing further is written.

identityResolution.description: A reviewer's governed decision on a quarantined identity. It never comes from the applicant.

applicantOrganisation.description: Applicant organisation evidence (ADR-BCP-017 section 7). Recorded as claims; it establishes nothing on its own.

corporateRelationshipClaim.description: A corporate relationship the applicant declared (e.g. 'we are a subsidiary of Acme Holdings'). It is recorded PENDING_REVIEW with source_authority applicant-submission and is never verified by admission (section 69). The counterparty is an existing Organisation, named either by id or by governed identifiers that resolve to exactly one Organisation; an unresolvable counterparty is reported, not created.

applicant_role.description: Whether the applicant is the source (e.g. OWNS the counterparty) or the target (e.g. is OWNED by it).

platformAccountAssignment.description: Where the admitted Organisation sits commercially (ADR-BCP-018 sections 42-45). A PlatformAccount confers no tenant access.

account_role.description: The Organisation's role in the account. Defaults to PRIMARY_ACCOUNT_ORGANISATION for a new account and CONTRACTING_PARTY for an existing one.

OrganisationAdmissionRequest.description: Onboard the organisation behind an approved admission decision onto an already registered tenant. Issued by the admission reviewer, never by the applicant.

verification_case_id.description: The ADR-BCP-023 VerificationCase that verified the applicant's legal identity (sections 191-193). It must be VERIFIED and for purpose ORGANISATION_ADMISSION. Its subject is either the client application being admitted (subject APPLICATION, whose id must equal application_id; the usual case, since the case is worked before approval) or the admitted organisation or one of its legal entities. It needs VERIFIED REGISTRATION_IDENTIFIER and LEGAL_NAME claims about that subject. Only those accepted claims are promoted (section 192). Without it the legal entity stays unverified; there is no other way to verify legal identity at admission.

OrganisationAdmissionOutcome.description: What organisation onboarding converged on. A QUARANTINED outcome lists the Organisations whose governed identifiers match and carries no other results.
